name: Virgo
description: Virgo-1.0-Angkor: KSN's own assistant models for chat, speech and media, built on small open models and tuned to Virgo's voice, English and Khmer.

chat.method: QLoRA fine-tune (4-bit) on chat/data: Virgo's identity, tone, Khmer, answer style; scored with chat/eval
runs_on: Cloudflare Workers AI (LoRA, if the base is supported)

stt.method: fine-tune on Khmer + English speech (FLEURS km_kh by default)

transcribe.method: long-audio transcription with timestamps (30 s chunks) and optional .srt subtitles

tts.method: ready-made voices; fine-tune notes in speech/README.md

realtime.method: voice activity detection → speech to text → chat → text to speech, streamed over a WebSocket, answer spoken sentence by sentence

image.method: fast 1–4 step generation; optional Virgo style LoRA (image/train_style_lora.md)

video.method: text to video with real motion, 480p, about 5 seconds
